title: Septic Tank Servicers and Sewer Pipe Cleaners
description: Clean and repair septic tanks, sewer lines, or drains. May patch walls and partitions of tank, replace damaged drain tile, or repair breaks in underground piping.

projection.title: Septic tank servicers and sewer pipe cleaners

tasks.text: Communicate with supervisors and other workers, using equipment such as wireless phones, pagers, or radio telephones.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — On-site construction discussion is contextual, physical

dwas.name: Communicate with other construction or extraction personnel to discuss project details.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Drive trucks to transport crews, materials, and equipment.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Truck driving needs real-world navigation and control

dwas.name: Drive trucks or truck-mounted equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Inspect manholes to locate sewer line stoppages.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Plumbing inspection needs hands-on physical access

tasks.text: Operate sewer cleaning equipment, including power rodders, high-velocity water jets, sewer flushers, bucket machines, wayne balls, and vac-alls.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Equipment and facility cleaning is hands-on

tasks.text: Prepare and keep records of actions taken, including maintenance and repair work.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record operational or environmental data into logs

tasks.text: Clean and repair septic tanks, sewer lines, or related structures such as manholes, culverts, and catch basins.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Equipment and facility cleaning is hands-on

emerging.task: Pump, clean, and repair septic tanks, sewer lines, or related structures such as manholes, culverts, and catch basins.
emerging.original_task: Clean and repair septic tanks, sewer lines, or related structures such as manholes, culverts, and catch basins.

tasks.text: Measure excavation sites, using plumbers' snakes, tapelines, or lengths of cutting heads within sewers, and mark areas for digging.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical site dimension measurement

dwas.name: Measure work site dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Service, adjust, and make minor repairs to equipment, machines, and attachments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of construction tools

tasks.text: Locate problems, using specially designed equipment, and mark where digging must occur to reach damaged tanks or pipes.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical locating of worn parts needs hands-on presence

dwas.name: Locate equipment or materials in need of repair or replacement.

tasks.text: Dig out sewer lines manually, using shovels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual digging with tools in ground

tasks.text: Clean and disinfect domestic basements and other areas flooded by sewer stoppages.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Equipment and facility cleaning is hands-on

dwas.name: Decontaminate equipment or sites to remove hazardous or toxic substances.

tasks.text: Withdraw cables from pipes and examine them for evidence of mud, roots, grease, and other deposits indicating broken or clogged sewer lines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Plumbing inspection needs hands-on physical access

tasks.text: Ensure that repaired sewer line joints are tightly sealed before backfilling begins.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Installation inspection requires on-site physical check

dwas.name: Inspect completed work to ensure proper installation.

tasks.text: Rotate cleaning rods manually, using turning pins.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of mechanical equipment

tasks.text: Install rotary knives on flexible cables mounted on machine reels, according to the diameters of pipes to be cleaned.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment attachment

tasks.text: Start machines to feed revolving cables or rods into openings, stopping machines and changing knives to conform to pipe sizes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Equipment and facility cleaning is hands-on

dwas.name: Operate heavy-duty construction or installation equipment.

tasks.text: Update sewer maps and manhole charts.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document editing largely automatable with human review

tasks.text: Cover repaired pipes with dirt, and pack backfilled excavations, using air and gasoline tampers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating compaction equipment by hand on site

dwas.name: Spread sand, dirt or other loose materials onto surfaces.
Compact materials to create level bases.

tasks.text: Cut damaged sections of pipe with cutters, remove broken sections from ditches, and replace pipe sections, using pipe sleeves.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Plumbing repair is manual dexterity in situ

dwas.name: Remove worn, damaged or outdated materials from work areas.

tasks.text: Requisition or order tools and equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Construction procurement needs human supplier judgment

dwas.name: Order construction or extraction materials or equipment.

tasks.text: Break asphalt and other pavement so that pipes can be accessed, using airhammers, picks, and shovels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Breaking rock and concrete is physical labor

dwas.name: Break up rock, asphalt, or concrete.

tasks.text: Tap mainline sewers to install sewer saddles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling construction materials is hands-on tool work
